snippet.title: DeeSicks - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
What if every roll could turn you into a bullet hell god?

DeeSicks is a chaotic action experience where physics-based dice rolls shape your build and define your power.

Aim, collide, and place your dice strategically to create unstoppable combinations and dominate intense bullet hell battles.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3913890/DeeSicks/

🎲 About the Game

🎯 Dice-Based Strategy
• Aim and roll dice using physics-based mechanics
• Every throw can completely change your build

⚙️ Build Your Power
• Combine dice, spells, and relics
• Create unique and powerful synergies

🧠 Strategic Decisions
• Choose between different archetypes and playstyles
• Adapt your strategy as your run evolves

🔥 Bullet Hell Combat
• Face intense and chaotic battles
• Become your own boss with overwhelming power

📈 Progression and Variety
• Multiple characters and board systems
• Unlock new strategies and combinations every run
